items.title: Joe Decosimo, patriarch of Chattanooga business community, dies at 101
items.summary: Joe Decosimo, who helped generations of Chattanooga business leaders as an accountant and public servant and was the patriarch of an influential and expansive local family, died on Saturday at 101.
